gaps.what: Western Carniola line of the Italian occupation is a 30 km disc at Postojna plus Idrija
gaps.why: page silent: the Villa Giusti and Rapallo pages name no line

gaps.what: Eight of the 18 Prekmurje municipalities in the exclusion are the researcher's completion (the page names eleven of 19); the Međimurje withdrawal of the Hungarian troops is undated; Rijeka's own status in November 1918 (international force) is folded into the Italian zone
Extent stays a 60 km disc round Vilnius (infobox 13,490 km2); the Republic's real boundary is not on any page opened
gaps.why: page silent: the Wilno Voivodeship page (29,011 km2, 1926) is a later, larger unit

problems: Disagreement recorded: the review cites the SHS footnote 'Prekmurje annexed by Hungary' as 1918 evidence, but the page puts it in the Slovenia row 'Annexed by Italy, Germany, and Hungary' without a date; the exclusion rests on the Prekmurje page instead (Hungarian Democratic Republic, Yugoslav troops took control 12 August 1919). Prekmurje subtracted as 18 municipalities, not Murska Sobota alone.

Cross-dossier, not edited: serbs/ledger/28 (counterpart austria-hungary) and austria-hungary/ledger/36 hand Sremski to serbs; both should name state-of-slovenes-croats-and-serbs. austria-hungary/ledger/30 still hands Prekmurje and Medimurje to the SHS state.

Cross-dossier, not edited: yugoslavia/ledger/4 gains Medimurska and Murska Sobota from hungarian-republic only at Trianon (1920/6); the Prekmurje page says Yugoslav troops took control on 12 August 1919 and the Medimurje County page says it joined the Kingdom on 9 January 1919. yugoslavia/ledger/2 gains Maribor from the Austrian republic in September 1919 though the Maister page has the State holding it from 23 November 1918. yugoslavia and kingdom-of-italy have no event for the Italian occupation of northern Dalmatia, Rijeka and western Carniola 1918-1921.
central-lithuania: one disc should be used by the compiler (47 km kingdom-of-lithuania, 60 km here and in second-polish-republic's vassal_start/end, 100 km in second-polish-republic's gain).
Pages for the thin items: the Italian occupation of the eastern Adriatic page returned url_not_found; Fiume/Maribor/Carinthia facts came from the Rijeka, Rudolf Maister and Treaty of Rapallo pages.
